channel.title: Pariksha Result 2026 - Latest Sarkari Jobs, Results & Admit Card
channel.description: Official real-time notifications for latest Sarkari Naukri, Admit Card, Results, Answer Key, Syllabus & Schemes.

item.title: SSC JE Recruitment 2026: 1,748 Junior Engineer Vacancies
item.description: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released official notification for Junior Engineer Examination 2026 for 1,748 Group 'B' vacancies across various central government departments in Civil, Electrical, and Mechanical streams.

item.title: India Post GDS Recruitment 2026: 23,757 Vacancies
item.description: India Post has released Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) Schedule-II July 2026 recruitment notification for 23,757 vacancies across India. 10th pass candidates can apply online without written examination for BPM, ABPM, and Dak Sevak posts.

item.title: PM Awas Yojana Urban 2.0 2026: Financial Assistance & Online Apply
item.description: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0) aims to assist 1 crore urban poor and middle-income families with financial aid up to Rs 2.50 lakh for house construction or purchase, and interest subsidy up to Rs 1.80 lakh on home loans.

item.title: Navodaya Vidyalaya Class 9th & 11th Admission 2027
item.description: Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS) has invited online applications for Lateral Entry Selection Test 2027 for admission to Class 9th and Class 11th for academic session 2027-28. Eligible students studying in Class 8th or 10th during 2026-27 can apply online before 30 September 2026.

item.title: Rajasthan Palanhar Yojana 2026
item.description: Under Rajasthan Palanhar Yojana 2026, the state government provides monthly financial assistance of Rs 1,500 to Rs 2,500 per child along with an annual lump-sum aid of Rs 2,000 to support orphan and needy children aged 0 to 18 years.

item.title: SBI Asha Scholarship Yojana 2026
item.description: SBI Foundation has released notification for SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship 2026-27. Students studying from Class 9 to Post Graduation, IIT, IIM, Medical, and overseas education can receive scholarship benefits ranging from Rs 15,000 to Rs 20 Lakh.

item.title: Rajasthan Work from Home Job Recruitment 2026: 8,910 Posts
item.description: Department of Women and Child Development Rajasthan has invited online applications under Mukhyamantri Work From Home Scheme for 8,910 vacancies. 8th Pass female residents of Rajasthan can apply online for tailoring/sewing work from home.

item.title: Rajasthan University BA 2nd Semester Result 2026
item.description: Rajasthan University (UNIRAJ) has officially declared the BA 2nd Semester Result 2026 on its official result portal. Students can check their results online using their roll number and date of birth.

item.title: Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship 2026
item.description: Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship Programme 2026-27 provides financial assistance up to Rs 18,000 to students studying in class 11th, 12th, graduation, diploma, polytechnic, and ITI courses. Eligible candidates can apply online before 26 October 2026.

item.title: IIT JEE Advanced Admission 2026
item.description: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) has opened the registration portal for JEE Advanced 2026 entrance exam for admission into B.Tech/B.E./Dual Degree engineering programs across 23 IITs.

item.title: Mukhyamantri Rajshri Yojana 2026
item.description: Department of Women and Child Development, Rajasthan invites eligible residents to apply for Mukhyamantri Rajshri Yojana 2026. Under this flagship welfare scheme, financial assistance of up to ₹50,000 is provided to girl children from birth until Class 12.

item.title: UPSC Civil Services Answer Key 2026
item.description: Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the Official Answer Key for General Studies Paper I and Paper II (CSAT) of the Civil Services Preliminary Examination 2026.

item.title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level Admit Card 2026
item.description: Railway Recruitment Boards (RRB) have released the CBT-1 Exam Admit Card and City Intimation Slip for Non-Technical Popular Categories (NTPC) Graduate Level posts.

item.title: India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Merit List Cut Off Marks and Selection Strategy
item.description: India Post GDS 2026 recruitment process relies entirely on Class 10th marks without any written exam. This detailed guide covers state-wise expected cut-off trends, document verification checklist, and practical tips to secure your post office seat.

item.title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana 2026: Online Registration, Benefits & Zero Balance Account Details
item.description: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) 2026 offers financial inclusion to every Indian household through zero balance bank accounts. Account holders get a free RuPay debit card, accident insurance cover up to Rs 2 Lakh, and an overdraft facility of up to Rs 10,000. Read this complete practical guide to understand the step-by-step online and offline application process.

item.title: 📝 SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 & Tier 2 Master Preparation Strategy: 90-Day Proven Blueprint
item.description: Master the SSC CGL 2026 examination with our comprehensive 90-day blueprint. Covers Tier 1 and Tier 2 syllabus breakdown, high-yield topics in Quant, Reasoning, English, General Awareness, and Computer Knowledge with daily time tables and mock test protocols.

item.title: 📝 Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) 2026: Gramin & Urban Online Application & Subsidy Guide
item.description: Everything you need to know about Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) 2026 Urban & Gramin (Rural) scheme. Check eligibility criteria, ₹2.67 Lakh interest subsidy benefits, Aadhaar verification steps, and status tracking portal.

item.title: 📝 RRB NTPC & Group D 2026: Mathematics, Reasoning & General Science Speed Blueprint
item.description: Proven roadmap for Indian Railways RRB NTPC Graduate/Undergraduate & Group D exams. Includes speed tricks for CBT 1 and CBT 2, General Science Class 9-10 NCERT summaries, and Physical Efficiency Test (PET) guidelines.

item.title: 📝 UPSC CSE Prelims 2026: GS Paper 1 & CSAT Master Survival Blueprint
item.description: Comprehensive guide to clearing UPSC Civil Services Prelims 2026. Covers Indian Polity (Laxmikanth), Modern History (Spectrum), Environment (Shankar IAS), Economy (Ramesh Singh), and CSAT Paper II survival strategies for non-maths background candidates.

item.title: 🏆 [Result Announcement] NTA CUET UG Result & Normalized Percentile Scorecard 2026

item.title: Rajasthan LDC & Junior Assistant Recruitment 2026
item.description: Rajasthan Subordinate and Ministerial Services Selection Board (RSMSSB) has released online recruitment applications for Lower Division Clerk (LDC) / Clerk Grade II and Junior Assistant posts across government departments.

item.title: UP Police Constable Answer Key 2026
item.description: Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB) has published the official provisional answer key and master question paper for UP Police Constable Recruitment Examination 2026. Objections can be raised online.

item.title: SSC CGL Online Form 2026 Notification
item.description: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has officially issued the notification for Combined Graduate Level (CGL) Examination 2026. Interested candidates holding a Bachelor Degree can apply online at ssc.gov.in.

item.description: Rajasthan Subordinate and Ministerial Services Selection Board (RSMSSB) has declared the final result and scorecard for the Common Eligibility Test (CET) Senior Secondary Level 2026. Candidates can check their scorecards via SSO portal.

item.title: India Post GDS Recruitment 2026
item.description: Department of Posts (India Post) invites online applications for Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS), Branch Postmaster (BPM), and Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM) posts across multiple circles nationwide. Merit is based strictly on 10th standard marks.

item.title: India Post GDS Recruitment 2026: State-Wise Cut Off, Merit List & Selection Strategy
item.description: India Post GDS 2026 selection strictly depends on your Class 10th marks—no written exam needed! To secure a seat as Branch Postmaster (BPM) or Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM), understanding circle-wise cut-off trends and keeping your Document Verification (DV) file bulletproof is key.

item.title: PM Jan Dhan Yojana 2026: Zero Balance Account Benefits, Overdraft Rules & Online Registration Guide
item.description: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) 2026 allows Indian citizens to open zero-balance bank accounts with built-in ₹2 Lakh accidental insurance cover and a free RuPay debit card. Eligible account holders can also access an overdraft facility of up to ₹10,000 after 6 months of active account usage. Here is the complete blueprint covering eligibility rules, document requirements, and application procedures.
